question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) KT – OH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ceff098a6e237284f9906ab88047a968c48ab5480d698946696143597d69508.png] 

Option 2) YH – CV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0496c07cb52a2c564361c9ca195701323abb9966f913e8dc3f9e25fa1b03bb2d.png] 

Option 3) BK – EY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/558a313ae7684510424798e9da8463270dc10060f3794e1f392078d1597f6255.png] 

Option 4) JS – NG

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55249fab61a2ee0140e66bc3cdf5ea524687d8264433332b6cf3c815009e1a44.png] 

Thus, out of all 'BK – EY' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
